purpose: Test whether public MUSE spectroscopy can supply at least three resolved RX J2129 BCG dynamical bins on the same 5-arcsec support as three spectroscopic strong-lens images from three source families.
blindness_rule: The system, 5-arcsec target support, annuli, circular geometry, masks, templates, uncertainty checks, and pass thresholds are frozen from lens positions and archive metadata before extracting a BCG velocity dispersion.

input.astrometric_registration: fit a fixed-n=4.05 circular continuum model robustly and treat the offset from the published BCG center as a global cube-WCS correction

spatial_extraction.geometry_rationale: use circular annuli for the structural engineering gate so no Lenstool ellipticity or position-angle convention is imported into the dynamics

mask_protocol.stage_1: mask non-finite DATA/STAT values and non-positive variance
mask_protocol.stage_2: construct a white-light image from the median over 6000-7000 Angstrom
mask_protocol.stage_3: subtract a 3-pixel Gaussian-smoothed white-light image to form a compact-source detection image
mask_protocol.stage_4: flag positive compact residual components above 6 robust sigma with 2-300 connected pixels, excluding the registered central 3.0 arcsec
mask_protocol.stage_5: dilate flagged components by 8 pixels and freeze the mask before spectral fitting

spectral_fit.mask_high_variance_pixels: exclude wavelength planes whose annular variance median exceeds the local 21-pixel median by 6 robust sigma
spectral_fit.noise_model: sum STAT variance over unmasked spaxels and rescale conditional pPXF errors by square root of reduced chi-square

covariance_protocol.spatial_resampling: 100 deterministic spatial block-bootstrap replicates within each annulus using 2x2-spaxel blocks
covariance_protocol.template_systematic: repeat with XSL templates if available; otherwise mark this component missing
covariance_protocol.reported_covariance: sum bootstrap and between-protocol covariance and preserve all off-diagonal terms

success_thresholds.publication_figure_use: none; no published BCG dispersion profile is used as a numerical target
